jobs.description: I ship full-stack features across GoMeddo’s product suite, owning the work from early requirements through release, and I lead much of our push to use AI to ship faster and more consistently. My day-to-day spans React, Python, Apex, and AWS.

I consulted with clients to analyze, optimize, and extend their Salesforce environments and integrations, building well-tested solutions in JavaScript, Apex, and SOQL. I also coached client teams and junior developers through the delivery process.

I led the move to a version-control-driven development model and modernized how we tested, refactoring Apex unit tests around mocking frameworks and introducing test-driven development for Lightning Web Components with Jest. I delivered full-stack work across Experience, Sales, and Service Clouds, managed CI/CD pipelines, profiled and improved platform performance with New Relic, and supported internal teams with CPQ enhancements.

I delivered Salesforce CPQ consulting and implementation for B2B clients, working closely with the VP of Customer Solutions to shape strategy for each engagement. I built features in Lightning Components, JavaScript, and Apex that extended CPQ to match how each client actually sold.

I designed, built, and maintained Salesforce web applications for clients, troubleshooting issues across both Salesforce and Boomi middleware. I worked with technical teams to plan and ship solutions, ran client demos, and provided hands-on technical guidance throughout each project.

I built front-end and back-end features for a recurring-billing web application using PHP, JavaScript, Java, Python, and MySQL. I also handled customer implementations and wrote the monthly feature-update newsletter.
